html:
The Ngumbarl are an Aboriginal people of the coast of Western Australia just north of present day Broome, at the base of the Dampier Peninsula.

Their language belonged to the Nyulnyulan family, like those of the Nyulnyul to the north and the Jabirrjabirr nearby. It is now extinct and was poorly recorded. The pearling industry that grew around Broome from the 1880s took over this coast and its people. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Ngumbarl are an Aboriginal people of the coast of Western Australia just north of present day Broome, at the base of the Dampier Peninsula.
